neighbours.label: the 'plan' word stem across languages (plan, planned/unplanned, planners, планир-, Pläne), not synonyms or look-alike 'plant'
fire: Before the trip we sat down to plan every stop along the coast.
The merger was planned months before it was announced.
Мы планируем открыть новый магазин весной.
Their wedding planner booked the hall and the band.
The strike caused an unplanned delay at the port.
Die Stadt stellte neue Pläne für den Park vor.
Next year the council will plan a second bus route.
Las obras no planificadas dañaron el viejo puente.
